links.outcome: Overall esophageal cancer staging accuracy of LLMs versus clinicians on same reports
links.effect: INF-72B+IR achieved 61.5% accuracy and F1 0.60 versus clinicians' 39.5% and 0.39 (P<.001); Qwen2.5-72B+IR 46%; LLaMA3.1-70B not significantly different from clinicians.
links.quote: INF-72B+IR achieved a superior overall staging accuracy of 61.5% and an F1-score of 0.60, substantially higher than the clinicians' accuracy of 39.5% and F1-score of 0.39 (all P<.001).

unlisted_practices: Interpretable reasoning prompting strategy versus zero-shot and chain-of-thought for LLM staging
Local deployment of open-weight LLMs for radiology report interpretation

screen.reason: The study evaluates LLMs for esophageal cancer staging from free-text radiology reports and compares performance across prompting strategies (zero-shot, chain-of-thought, and interpretable reasoning) against clinician performance.
